    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }
    // Get Source and Destination
    var source = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');

    // Passenger Count
    var numPassengers = Number(newValue);

    // Get Journey Type
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');

    // Ameerpet → Madhapur
    if (source == 'a7d4a90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45ac0' &&
        destination == '9535e90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45a94') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → LB Nagar
    else if (source == 'a7d4a90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45ac0' &&
             destination == '8cf42d0c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45a9f') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹50 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 50
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹100 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 100
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → Kukatpally
    else if (source == 'a7d4a90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45ac0' &&
             destination == '7de4e90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45a8c') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → Jubilee Hills
    else if (source == 'a7d4a90c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45ac0' &&
             destination == '0b05214c3b938310c65b8e0f23e45a58') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹20 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 20
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹40 per passenger

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 40
            );
        }
    }
    else {
        // Clear amounts if no route matches
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
    }
}
